premises.text: Consumer nav apps pre-compute routes and assume traffic stays fixed during a drive, so they miss the truly fastest path and reroute constantly
premises.evidence_span: They assume traffic doesn't change during the course of your drive

premises.text: TallyGo's time-dependent routing layer ingests minute-level sensor traffic data so each road segment is costed when the driver is expected to reach it
premises.evidence_span: time-dependent routing, where the cost of each stretch of road is calculated based on when you're actually expected to reach each turn

premises.text: Businesses that move people or goods lack embeddable real-time turn-by-turn navigation in their own apps, forcing costly app-switching or DIY builds
premises.evidence_span: embeddable navigation simply doesn't exist today

premises.text: TallyGo Navigation SDK lets any company embed real-time turn-by-turn navigation with a few lines of integration code
premises.evidence_span: any company can embed real-time, turn-by-turn navigation directly into their existing apps

value.text: Companies get the actual fastest, dynamically updating routes embedded in their own apps for moving people and goods
value.evidence_span: we find the actual fastest route, which is one that other apps have likely already excluded

causal_links.evidence_span: This is why these apps reroute you so frequently
